title: Keep every plan identity unique

facts.note: Any scanned plan artifact (train, interlocking, journey, wagon, WMBT, acceptance, …) that declares an identity field (train_id, interlocking_id, journey_id, urn, …), wherever it lives; only vendored/generated trees (node_modules, dist, build, _generated) are excluded. Applies regardless of the current operation.
Duplicate detection requires the planner_plan_integrity validator to compare declared identities across all parsed plan artifacts, including pre-existing duplicates.

fires: Planner adds a new journey whose journey_id already exists in another plan artifact.
Planner copies an existing acceptance as a template and keeps its urn unchanged.
Two existing train artifacts already declare the same train_id when the plan is validated, even though the current task did not touch them.
doesNotFire: A duplicate identity appears only inside node_modules, dist, build or _generated trees.
An artifact references another artifact's identity (a reference, not a declaration).
Every scanned plan artifact declares an identity that no other scanned artifact declares.

given: the scanned plan artifacts, each declaring an identity (train_id, interlocking_id, journey_id, urn, …)
when: the plan is authored or validated — whether an artifact is being created, copied, renamed, or a duplicate already exists
then: ensure no two plan artifacts declare the same identity.
prefer: When a duplicate is found, rename one of the artifacts, or merge them.
Check the existing plan artifacts for the identity before declaring it in a new or copied artifact.
avoid: Copying an artifact as a template and leaving its identity unchanged.
Keeping two artifacts with the same identity and relying on whichever is read first to win.
Silencing the finding by moving a plan artifact into a vendored or generated tree.
unless: The artifacts live in vendored or generated trees (node_modules, dist, build, _generated), which are never scanned.
why: A reference to a duplicated identity resolves to whichever file was read first, so references become ambiguous and order-dependent.
evidence: The planner_plan_integrity validator reports no duplicate identity across scanned plan artifacts.
Reviewer confirms each identity occurs in exactly one artifact declaration.
verifier_detail: Implemented by validator planner_plan_integrity; compares declared identity fields (train_id, interlocking_id, journey_id, urn, and other identity keys) across all parsed plan artifacts.
Skip vendored and generated trees: node_modules, dist, build, _generated.
Severity 3, disposition strict: every duplicate is a failure.
audit: Package rule (atdd-bun.*), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node.

sharedNodes.text: package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (atdd-bun.*), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node. It is held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.
Strict: fails on every finding, no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.
